name: web-session
description: External web-session CONSUMER: the ONE multiplexed browser tool `session` (action enum open|act|read|close) with persistent storage-state sessions per site label, auto (re-)login from credential NAMEs, change DELTAS instead of page dumps, CSS/XPath/role+name selector reads, and JSON/XHR endpoint discovery with direct endpoint calls - all on the chromium shared with web-page

stateDir.description: where the storage-state files and the spill files live (default: <tmp>/workbench-web-session; the dev config points it at .workbench/web-session, which is git-ignored)

idleTtlSeconds.description: idle seconds after which a live session is evicted (its state is persisted first; 0 = never idle)

maxSessions.description: how many sessions may be live at once; the least recently used is evicted first

defaultSite.description: the site label used when a call omits `site` (default: the only configured site)

hardMaxChars.description: cap a caller can never exceed

deltaMaxChars.description: cap of a delta payload (what changed after an act)

maxDeltaNodes.description: how many text nodes a delta may report per list

maxSelectorNodes.description: how many elements a selector-scoped read may return

maxEndpoints.description: how many discovered JSON/XHR endpoints the list may hold

maxSteps.description: how many `act` steps one call may carry

actionTimeoutMs.description: per-step timeout and bounded settle budget

retries.description: extra navigation attempts after a transport failure

waitUntil.description: navigation wait strategy (a bounded settle runs after it)

executablePath.description: chromium binary; absent: playwright resolves it (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH)

blockResourceTypes.description: resource types never downloaded (default image, media, font)

proxy.description: per-request proxy; `credential` is a credential NAME resolved at launch time, never a value

redact.description: strings scrubbed from every error envelope

sites.description: the site table: label -> baseUrl + stateFile + allowOrigins + login flow + optional readPath. One entry per site; nothing is hardcoded in the plugin

baseUrl.description: the site root; a relative call url resolves against it

allowOrigins.description: extra origins the site's JSON endpoints may live on (the site origin is always allowed)

readPath.description: API-first read: the endpoint ref used by `read` when no selector is given

login.description: the auto (re-)login flow; it runs when the `indicator` selector matches (or when no stored state was found)

url.description: the login page (absolute, or relative to baseUrl)

indicator.description: selector that matches while LOGGED OUT

submit.description: the submit control; absent: Enter on the last field

credential.description: credential NAME resolved through ctx.credentials at login time (never a value)

value.description: a literal, non-secret value used when `credential` is absent
